name: Kling female · 原版 · 三分之四视角 · 短袖上衣与短裙 · 裙摆修订
provenance:
Separate motion-flow review candidate compiled only from existing approved Kling frames. Selected native RGBA pixels, source IDs, anchor, source-clock positions and cycle periods are exact. Fast moving poses omitted by the earlier 52-drawing loop study are restored. Jump retains all 39 original frames and plays once, including the original upright recovery. The earlier crouched-hop loop study and original packs remain separate and unchanged. Optional motionFlow metadata schedules reviewed contact/landing transitions and returns Jump to Idle in a supporting player. Other V2/V3 players play the ordinary manifest clips and hold the final jump frame. There is no interpolation, redraw, warping, recentering, new source extraction or wardrobe/skeletal generation. Original blur, pose drift, jump-apex scalp clipping and missing transition drawings remain visible. Scheduling reduces abrupt airborne exits but cannot create a perfect missing anticipation/outro.

Original source provenance:
User-supplied Kling source artwork. Imported through the external Gathria Unified CharacterPack 1.0.0 contract. Each native-resolution RGBA frame is packed without resampling, thresholding, recoloring or regeneration; duplicate pixels share atlas cells while frame order and FPS remain intact. Clothing, body and shoes are baked together. This is not an editable skeletal or wardrobe identity. Source action selection is a loop candidate, not final artistic acceptance. The optional jump is a forward one-shot source sequence, not a looping or synthesized pose.

Wardrobe and appearance: registered garment patches replace only clothing ownership. Per-pose hair uses transparent source-over/front and destination-over/back layers; face replacement is restricted to the authored inner-face ownership and retains source alpha. Source hands and the dressed body remain protected. Declared transparent padding translates every source pixel and the anchor by the same integer offset without scaling; atlas rectangles are repacked. Frame pixels, frame IDs, native FPS and source-frame/time mapping are unchanged. This is baked playback, with editable assets retained separately in the wardrobe project. Gameplay profile kling-female-original-single-jump-v1: the basic jump uses one reviewed complete native takeoff/landing sequence. The complete original source archive remains unchanged in the editable project. Action frame selection and transitions follow sourceMetadata.gameplayMotion; no interpolated, blended or re-centered frame artwork is introduced.

暖杏色 · 褶裥短裙 · 原版: Original-view cream blouse and rose shortskirt artwork generated with OpenAI imagegen; source references, generated donor image and processing provenance recorded in artwork/dual-tailored/female. The exact generation prompt was not retained. Eight donor poses were explored; the final bank uses the standing donor cloth continuously to avoid donor-switch flicker. Only traced clothing is used; generated faces, anatomy, shoes and background are discarded. One coherent painted bodice, independently anchored near/far puff sleeves and one continuous skirt fold layout are fitted offline to each unchanged source pose. Head/hand protection and uncovered source RGBA remain exact. Cloth alpha may extend the silhouette within explicit ownership; no runtime AI, source/body warp or timing changes. Browser clothing variant owned-chromatic-ratio-v1; base SHA256 60d9b80fb2fc273e8d3f822b2ae85737daedd9bd6849f3f8d3713196c4891168; design SHA256 40ad6b678e176c34f36dc0beb2e289314acfad9575e7ffb4acc6e15e8aa2d15e. Owned opaque RGB only, ties-to-even rounding; source, ownership, alpha, anchors, pose geometry and timing retained. Reference none is palette/design context only, never auto-fitted artwork.

Side gentle is a separately reviewed compact mouth-only derivative of the native source, preserving other features and action expressions. No runtime retargeting or image generation. Provenance and review: artwork/dual-looks/appearance and artwork/dual-looks/side-face.

notes: Zero-based decoded video frame indices. Every selected frame is played forward once at the original 24 fps; no duplicated endpoint, ping-pong, interpolation or morphing.
Fixed per-character crop only. No scaling, per-frame recentering, stabilization, skeleton fitting, repainting or facial correction.
Ground anchor is a fixed reference near the standing soles, not a per-frame foot lock or anatomical measurement.
Background alpha is estimated from each source green-screen profile. Only partially transparent edge RGB is unmixed/despilled; every fully opaque pixel retains decoded source RGB exactly.
Original source motion blur, pose variation and small cycle mismatch remain visible. These are reviewed loop candidates, not user-approved final animation.
Jump is a single forward performance, source frames171–209 inclusive at24fps, then holds its final frame. No celebration frames substitute for jump.

All frames gain32 transparent canvas pixels above the old crop; anchor moves by the same32pixels. Existing four actions retain identical RGBA after removing this padding. No visible artwork is shifted relative to its anchor.
The original videos cut a small scalp arc at source frames183–186. New canvas includes every source pixel but cannot reconstruct artwork missing from the video.
